description: This file defines UI components and theme objects for an Android TV frontend using Jetpack Compose. It includes color schemes, spacing, typography, various composable UI widgets like image banners, section rows, chips, icon buttons, and poster cards, along with utility functions for image loading and styling.

methods.name: StreamXTVTheme
methods.description: Defines the dark theme for the TV app using MaterialTheme with custom color and typography schemes.

methods.name: figmaImage
methods.description: Generates a File object referencing a Figma image file from a base assets directory.

methods.name: SvgImage
methods.description: Loads and displays an image (SVG/PNG) from local assets using Coil.

methods.name: HeroBanner
methods.description: Displays a large hero image cropped to size, with focusability.

methods.name: RowSection
methods.description: Creates a horizontally scrollable section with a title and list of items.

methods.name: TagChip
methods.description: Creates a small rounded button-like chip for tagging or labels.

methods.name: TvIconButton
methods.description: Builds a circular button with optional icon overlay for TV controls.

methods.name: PosterCard
methods.description: A card widget showing a poster image with optional progress bar and trailing icons, and focus handling.

methods.name: borderGlow
methods.description: Adds a border glow effect to a Modifier, used for focus indication.
